provenance: synthetic transcript excerpts covering exactly the 5 cases C15 lists (sidechain line, foreign sessionId, truncated first line of a tail window, a line split across the 64KB boundary simulated via an explicit window_start byte offset, a [1m] model id); tokens = input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens per C1's last_usage definition, outputTokens = message.usage.output_tokens, byteOffset = cumulative UTF-8 bytes of the lines actually read (LF-terminated). this_session for the fixture is c9803d8e-256f-4c41-8e5d-787ea2ce385c, matching the session id used throughout fixtures-S2 (records-canonical.json, marker/valid.json) for continuity across S2/S3 fixtures.

cases.name: sidechain_line_skipped
cases.note: the sidechain line (isSidechain:true) is excluded by C1's last_usage definition; the newest NON-sidechain assistant usage line in this session wins (msg_main_1)

cases.name: foreign_sessionId_skipped
cases.note: sessionId !== this session is excluded per C1 last_usage definition (P0-g); the foreign line is ignored even though it is newer in wall-clock terms within the same file

cases.name: truncated_first_line_of_tail_window
cases.note: usage.cjs windowed tail read (64KB->256KB->...) can start mid-line; the first line of the window is dropped as unparsable JSON and the reader proceeds from the next newline-terminated line

cases.name: line_split_across_64KB_boundary
cases.note: C1 usage.cjs read path widens 64KB -> 256KB -> 1MB -> 4MB precisely for this case: a line straddling the window boundary is unparsable at 64KB and the reader must retry with the next larger window, which starts before the split and captures the whole line

cases.name: model_id_1m_suffix_sets_window
cases.note: C1: W = 200000, or 1000000 when the transcript's message.model ends in [1m] (EXOVAULT_WINDOW overrides both)
